answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the generated API types differ from the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts. The log shows new fields in the generated output (e.g. has_more, last_verified_at, tenant_name) that the PR did not commit. This is deterministic and tied to the backend DTO changes, so a rerun will fail the same way. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the updated api-types.d.ts.
